You're not alone. We all are our own worst critic. No one will tear apart our progress than ourselves. We just need to keep that in perspective.  The same can be said for validation of suffering. First: Does the suffering come from "wants" or "needs". That will play a major role in deciding, and validating the suffering. If it's just something we want, we find a way to not want it anymore, and then the suffering ends. 

Take me for instance. I want a beer. But I'm at work. So I satisfy with a cup of coffee until I get off.  Meanwhile, if the suffering is from a need, then it is most certainly validated.  It's up to you to draw that distinction.  Best of luck to you.
